brief: Layout-aware tab shortcuts for Chrome and Firefox. A compact P and a forward arrow express the name in one silhouette.
criteria: Readable in the browser toolbar at 16 px; one-colour and reversed; preserve the established purple.

concepts.name: Push P
concepts.idea: A P whose counter pushes forward.
rationale: A single initial replaces four competing direction keys.
The transparent arrow survives monochrome reproduction.
The established purple connects the mark to the existing product.

recommendation: Approved direction B, refined in the existing purple.
next_steps: Use transparent small-size icons in the browser toolbar.
Use the dark tile for app and touch contexts.
